== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The 2006 +2 drain branch requires a Force drain you just initiated with Leia present. The early slip allows adding to a Force drain where she is present and leaves that actor and initiation restriction unstated. The 1 Force deploy/retrieve options are the same.
